mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of instances during easing periods, or the 20d returns are not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a t-test against baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% in a 3-month window signals labor market stress, leading to reduced corporate investment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3 percentage points in 3 months
failure_condition: The 5d returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when the trigger occurs, or the unemployment rate does not exceed 4.5% in the subsequent period.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and growth in GDP (GDPC1) signals accommodative monetary policy, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < previous month & GDPC1 > previous month
failure_condition: The 20d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when the proxies move in tandem, or the correlation between the proxies is below 0.5 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained drop in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below 110 signals weakening growth momentum, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20d returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during periods classified as late-cycle expansion, or the drop in INDPRO does not precede the return decline.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) indicates robust economic growth, boosting corporate earnings expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during periods of rising GDP, or the GDP growth rate does not correlate with return trends.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained fall in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below 110 points signals supply-side contraction, reducing corporate investment and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20d returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when INDPRO falls below 110, or the drop does not precede the return decline.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in housing starts (HOUST) and decline in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy supporting housing demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > previous month & FEDFUNDS < previous month
failure_condition: The 5d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when the proxies move in tandem, or their correlation is below 0.5 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: During a contraction regime, a sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals tight labor markets, prompting corporate cost-cutting and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20d returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during contraction periods when UNRATE falls below 4%, or the unemployment rate decline does not precede the return drop.
